fullPassage: To make art and design irresistible, the teacher must commit to providing opportunities that incite feelings of surprise and, thus motivational discovery and learning. This teaching approach is exciting — it allows the practitioner to consider what is tempting in learning, what drives an individual to find out and discover. The teacher needs to remember what it is about learning that makes it irresistible, and then design their lessons, their spaces of learning and their teaching materials accordingly. This is not teaching that rigidly conforms to an instructional, target-bound paradigm. It is essential to provide classrooms that have no ceiling when creative minds are operating and finding out. Classrooms of young children should be alive, dynamic and changeable, encouraged by a theme of the moment or an interest that pervades children's imaginations.

questions.passage: To make art and design (A)[irresistible / avoidable], the teacher must commit to providing opportunities that incite feelings of surprise and, thus motivational discovery and learning. This is not teaching that rigidly conforms to an instructional, target-bound paradigm. It is (C)[essential / trivial] to provide classrooms that have no ceiling when creative minds are operating and finding out. Classrooms of young children should be alive, dynamic and changeable, encouraged by a theme of the moment or an interest that pervades children's imaginations.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① irresistible — tempting — essential: 원문 일치. 예술 교육을 매력적으로(irresistible) 만들고, 학습에서 유혹적인(tempting) 것을 고려하며, 창의적 교실 제공이 필수적(essential)이라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② avoidable — tempting — essential: (A) avoidable(피할 수 있는)은 irresistible(매력적인)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ irresistible — repulsive — essential: (B) repulsive(혐오스러운)는 tempting(유혹적인)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ④ irresistible — tempting — trivial: (C) trivial(사소한)은 essential(필수적인)의 반의어로 부적절
det.tip: irresistible(매력적인) + tempting(유혹적인) + essential(필수적인) — 모두 예술 교육의 긍정적 특성

This is not teaching that rigidly conforms to an instructional, target-bound paradigm. It is essential to provide classrooms that have no ceiling when creative minds are operating and finding out. det.analysis:
❌ ① commit — randomly — dynamic: (B) randomly(무작위로)는 accordingly(그에 맞춰)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ② refuse — accordingly — dynamic: (A) refuse(거부하다)는 commit(전념하다)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ commit — accordingly — static: (C) static(정적인)은 dynamic(역동적인)의 반의어로 부적절
✅ ④ commit — accordingly — dynamic: 원문 일치. 교사가 전념하고(commit), 그에 맞춰(accordingly) 수업을 설계하며, 교실이 역동적(dynamic)이어야 한다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: commit to(전념하다) + accordingly(따라서) + dynamic(역동적인) — 교사의 능동적 교육 설계 흐름

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 design이 다음 두 문맥 (A), (B)에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① 설계하다 — 디자인(도안): (A) 수업을 설계하다(동사), (B) 패션 디자인/도안(명사). 두 의미 모두 정확 ←정답
❌ ② 의도하다 — 디자인(도안): (A) 수업을 '의도하다'는 부자연스러움. design their lessons = 수업을 설계하다
❌ ③ 설계하다 — 의도: (B) fashion design은 패션 도안/디자인이지 의도가 아님
❌ ④ 의도하다 — 의도: (A)(B) 모두 부적절
det.tip: design: 동사=설계하다/계획하다, 명사=디자인/도안/설계. 문맥으로 품사와 의미 구분

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to spread through and be present in every part of something"

det.korean: 어떤 것의 모든 부분에 퍼져 존재하다 → pervade(스며들다, 만연하다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① conform — 순응하다, 따르다. 퍼지는 의미가 아님
✅ ② pervade — 스며들다, 만연하다. 모든 부분에 퍼져 존재한다는 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ commit — 전념하다, 헌신하다. 퍼지는 의미가 아님
❌ ④ incite — 자극하다, 유발하다. 퍼지는 의미가 아님
det.tip: pervade = to spread through every part. 'an interest that pervades children's imaginations'

questions.passage: This teaching approach is exciting — it allows the practitioner to consider what is __________ (tempt) in learning, what drives an individual to find out and discover.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: be동사 뒤 보어 자리 → tempt의 형용사형 tempting(유혹적인)
det.analysis: what is __________ in learning에서 is 뒤 보어 자리이므로 형용사 필요. tempt(유혹하다, 동사) → tempting(유혹적인, 형용사/현재분사)
det.tip: be동사 + 형용사 구조. tempt → tempting (현재분사의 형용사적 용법: ~한 느낌을 주는)

questions.passage: It is essential to provide classrooms that have no ceiling when creative minds are __________ (operate) and finding out.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: are + __________ and finding out 병렬 구조 → operate의 현재분사 operating
det.analysis: are __________ and finding out에서 are + -ing 진행형 병렬 구조. finding과 병렬이므로 operate → operating. be동사 + 현재분사 = 진행형
det.tip: are operating and finding out — 병렬 구조(and)로 둘 다 -ing형. operate → operating

questions.passage: To make art and design irresistible, the teacher must __________ opportunities that incite feelings of surprise and, thus motivational discovery and learning. This teaching approach is exciting — it allows the practitioner to consider what is tempting in learning, what drives an individual to find out and discover. The teacher needs to remember what it is about learning that makes it irresistible, and then design their lessons, their spaces of learning and their teaching materials accordingly. This is not teaching that rigidly conforms to an instructional, target-bound paradigm. It is essential to provide classrooms that have no ceiling when creative minds are operating and finding out. Classrooms of young children should be alive, dynamic and changeable, encouraged by a theme of the moment or an interest that pervades children's imaginations.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 교사가 기회를 '제공하는 데 전념해야' 한다 → commit to providing
det.analysis:
❌ ① avoid creating — 만들기를 피하다. 본문 취지(적극적 기회 제공)에 반함
✅ ② commit to providing — 제공하는 데 전념하다. 원문 표현 그대로. 교사가 놀라움을 자극하는 기회를 제공하는 데 전념해야 한다는 맥락 ←정답
❌ ③ hesitate about offering — 제공을 주저하다. 전념의 반대
❌ ④ refrain from giving — 주는 것을 삼가다. 제공에 전념하는 맥락에 반함
det.tip: commit to providing = 제공하는 데 전념하다. commit to + V-ing 구조

questions.passage: To make art and design irresistible, the teacher must commit to providing opportunities that incite feelings of surprise and, thus motivational discovery and learning. This teaching approach is exciting — it allows the practitioner to consider what is tempting in learning, what drives an individual to find out and discover. The teacher needs to remember what it is about learning that makes it irresistible, and then design their lessons, their spaces of learning and their teaching materials accordingly. This is not teaching that __________ an instructional, target-bound paradigm. It is essential to provide classrooms that have no ceiling when creative minds are operating and finding out. Classrooms of young children should be alive, dynamic and changeable, encouraged by a theme of the moment or an interest that pervades children's imaginations.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이것은 교수법 패러다임에 '엄격하게 순응하는' 교육이 아니다 → rigidly conforms to
det.analysis:
❌ ① creatively adapts to — 창의적으로 적응하다. 원문과 다르고 부정문에서 이 표현을 쓰면 의미가 달라짐
❌ ② easily transitions into — 쉽게 전환되다. 원문에 없는 표현
❌ ③ naturally evolves from — 자연스럽게 진화하다. 원문에 없는 표현
✅ ④ rigidly conforms to — 엄격하게 순응하다. 원문: This is not teaching that rigidly conforms to an instructional paradigm. 부정문(not) 맥락에서 원문 그대로 ←정답
det.tip: rigidly conforms to = 엄격하게 순응하다. not + rigidly conforms to = 엄격하게 따르는 교육이 아님
